The capacity planning task succeeded with a perfect verifier reward by correctly implementing the required logic and passing the legacy pytest suite.
The run achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.82 across one trial with zero exceptions. The pytest tool (version 8.4.1) confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite. While the implementation is reusable, future iterations should re-check assumptions in the capacity model to improve the judge_reward closer to the verifier's ceiling.
